name: TaxiwebBooker
author: taxiid

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Taxiwebbooker to configure the widget options.
  4. For developers: The unminified source files for JavaScript are included in the plugin under the /src/ directory.

sections.description:
A modern, all-in-one taxi and chauffeur booking plugin for WordPress.

Advanced Taxi & Chauffeur Booking Plugin for WordPress

Easily integrate a powerful taxi and chauffeur booking system into your WordPress site. This plugin simplifies ride reservations, automates fare calculations, and supports multiple payment options, making taxi service management more efficient. Whether you operate a taxi business or need transportation booking functionality, this solution has everything you need.

Why Choose This Taxi Booking Plugin?

As demand for online ride-hailing increases, outdated manual booking methods and basic plugins no longer meet modern needs. This hosted, data-driven solution replaces traditional taxi booking systems, improving efficiency, automation, and customer experience. Manage bookings, track drivers, and process payments seamlessly—all from your WordPress dashboard.

Key Features

🚖 User-Friendly Interface
Intuitive design for both administrators and customers, ensuring a seamless booking experience.

⏳ Flexible Booking Options
Enable customers to book immediate rides or schedule future trips.

💲 Automatic Fare Calculation
Dynamically calculates fares based on distance, time, or custom pricing rules.

📊 Customizable Pricing
Set different rate plans based on distance, zones, or other factors.

💳 Multiple Payment Gateways
Securely accept payments through various payment providers.

📅 Booking Management & Dispatch Panel
Easily view, modify, or cancel bookings through an integrated dispatch system.

📍 Google Maps API Integration
Enhances route optimization and navigation for both customers and drivers.

📱 Mobile-Friendly & Responsive Design
Ensures a smooth booking experience on all devices.

🛠️ Address Autocomplete (Google API)
Improves the booking process with smart address suggestions.

⌚ Set Business Hours
Define operating schedules or allow 24/7 availability.

📆 Google Calendar Sync
Automatically logs bookings into the admin’s Google Calendar with customer-friendly event links.

📧 Custom Email Notifications
Send automated order confirmations, PDF receipts, and updates.

📲 SMS Notifications
Keep customers informed with real-time text message updates.

👤 Customer Portal
Allow registered users to log in and view their booking history.

🛒 Custom Checkout Fields
Customize checkout forms to collect necessary passenger details.

📜 PDF Booking Confirmations & Invoices
Generate and send PDF tickets or invoices for easy record-keeping.

🗺️ Define Service Areas with Google Maps
Set transportation zones and pricing using geofencing features.

🚖 Fleet Management Panel
Assign vehicles, track service status, and send automated notifications to drivers and customers.

This all-in-one taxi booking plugin provides a complete solution for taxi and chauffeur services, ensuring a smooth, automated, and hassle-free booking experience for both businesses and customers.

External services

This plugin embeds a widget from https://yourwebbooker.com. This widget is loaded client-side and used to display a booking interface from the Taxiwebbooker platform.

The plugin dynamically loads a JavaScript file from https://yourwebbooker.com/popup-widget/webbooker.js and a CSS stylesheet from https://yourwebbooker.com/popup-widget/styles.css. These files are hosted externally to support dynamic updates and user-specific configurations. The CSS is not bundled locally to ensure compatibility with the latest styling and layout updates.

This file is not included in the plugin folder itself, because it is dynamically generated and updated frequently to support integration and rendering logic tied to each account’s configuration. Hosting it remotely ensures the correct version is always served for a given widget setup.

This remote file is essential to the plugin’s service functionality. Without it, the booking interface cannot be rendered.

What data is sent?

No personal data is sent to the service unless the user interacts with the widget and submits a form.

Why is this needed?

The service is required to provide a live booking interface tied to the user’s Taxiwebbooker account. The external script supports dynamic updates and configuration management on the provider’s platform.

Source Code

The JavaScript files used in this plugin are minified for performance. The CSS is hosted externally.

The original, human-readable source code is included in the /assets/ directory within the plugin folder.
